ja: • アナライザーのコミカルなフォルムとカラーリングを再現。

en: • Reproduce the analyzer's comical form and coloring.
• The windshield and meter part of the head are reproduced with transparent parts.
• If you install a built-in LED unit (sold separately), you can enjoy the illumination of the meter part.
• There is a rotating gimmick on the body, and this rotation allows you to turn on/off the LED unit switch.
• Includes display stand and jet effects.
Molded product x 5, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
